title: [RPG Design Guides] Problems with Healing Magic

blocks.source: 【RPG制作講座】回復魔法の問題点
blocks.translation: [RPG Design Guides] Problems with Healing Magic

blocks.source: 戦闘バランスを取る上で最も難しいのは、なんといっても回復魔法である。
blocks.translation: The most difficult aspect of balancing combat is, without a doubt, healing magic.

blocks.source: ※この記事では、代表として『回復魔法』という言葉を使っていますが、『回復呪文』だろうが『回復アイテム』だろうが、本質は変わりません。
blocks.translation: ※In this article, I use the term “healing magic” as a representative example, but the same principle applies whether it is called “healing spells” or “healing items.”

blocks.source: 特に全体回復が強力過ぎる場合のバランス調整は非常に難しい。
blocks.translation: Balancing is especially difficult when full-party healing is too powerful.

blocks.source: どれだけダメージを受けていても、一度の回復魔法で立て直しができてしまうためだ。
blocks.translation: No matter how much damage the party has taken, a single healing spell can restore the situation.

blocks.source: これが低いコストで使用できてしまう場合、バランス調整が非常に難しくなる。
blocks.translation: If it can be used at a low cost, balancing becomes extremely difficult.

blocks.source: 『コストが低い』とは主に消費ＭＰが、小さいことを意味する。あるいは、消費ＭＰが大きくても、戦闘中、道具によって制限なくＭＰ回復できるなら大差はない。
blocks.translation: “Low cost” mainly means that it consumes little MP. Alternatively, even if it consumes a lot of MP, there is little difference if items can restore MP without limit during battle.

blocks.source: 適切な回復魔法の場合
blocks.translation: When Healing Magic Is Properly Balanced

blocks.source: ドラクエを例にして、ボス戦でのモデルケースを考えてみる。
blocks.translation: Using Dragon Quest as an example, let’s consider a model case for a boss battle.

blocks.source: 左が現在ＨＰ／右が最大ＨＰである。
blocks.translation: The value on the left is current HP, and the value on the right is maximum HP.
Luminary: HP 50/220
Warrior: HP 150/250
Thief: HP 180/200
Priest: HP 160/180

blocks.source: 状況としては……
blocks.translation: The situation is as follows…

blocks.source: 勇者はもはや瀕死。ただちに回復すべき。
blocks.translation: The Luminary is now near death and should be healed immediately.

blocks.source: 戦士は回復するに越したことはないが、後１ターンは耐えられるかも。
blocks.translation: It would be better to heal the Warrior, but they might be able to withstand one more turn.

blocks.source: 盗賊や僧侶はわずかにＨＰが減っているだけ。
blocks.translation: The Thief and Priest have only lost a small amount of HP.

blocks.source: 攻撃を受けにくい後衛であるので、後回しでもよい。
blocks.translation: Since they are back-row characters who are less likely to be attacked, they can wait.

blocks.source: 回復魔法は勇者がベホイミ、僧侶がベホマ、ベホマラーを使えるとする。
blocks.translation: Suppose the Luminary can use Midheal, while the Priest can use Fullheal and Multiheal.

blocks.source: 回復しながら戦うにはどうすればよいだろうか。
blocks.translation: How should you fight while healing?

blocks.source: ベホイミ ：消費は手頃な単体中回復
blocks.translation: Midheal: Moderate single-target healing at a reasonable cost

blocks.source: ベホマ ：消費は少し高いが単体全回復
blocks.translation: Fullheal: Full single-target healing at a somewhat high cost

blocks.source: ベホマラー：消費はかなり高いが全体中回復
blocks.translation: Multiheal: Moderate healing for the entire party at a very high cost

blocks.source: プレイヤーの状況判断によって、色々と考えられるはず。
blocks.translation: Depending on the player’s assessment of the situation, several options should come to mind.

blocks.source: 僧侶が勇者にベホマ、勇者が戦士にベホイミ、残り二人は攻撃。
blocks.translation: The Priest uses Fullheal on the Luminary, the Luminary uses Midheal on the Warrior, and the other two attack.

blocks.source: 僧侶が全員にベホマラー、勇者が自分にベホイミ、残り二人は攻撃。
blocks.translation: The Priest uses Multiheal on everyone, the Luminary uses Midheal on themself, and the other two attack.

blocks.source: 僧侶が勇者にベホマ、残り三人は攻撃。
blocks.translation: The Priest uses Fullheal on the Luminary, and the other three attack.

blocks.source: 僧侶が全員にベホマラー、残り三人は攻撃。
blocks.translation: The Priest uses Multiheal on everyone, and the other three attack.

blocks.source: このような選択肢が発生するのは、全体回復の消費や効果が制限されていてこそ。
blocks.translation: Options like these only arise when the cost or effect of full-party healing is limited.

blocks.source: 強力過ぎる回復魔法の場合
blocks.translation: When Healing Magic Is Too Powerful

blocks.source: これが……
blocks.translation: Suppose that…

blocks.source: ベホマラー：消費は手頃な全体全回復
blocks.translation: Multiheal: Full-party full healing at a reasonable cost

blocks.source: だったとしたら、選択肢はほぼなくなってしまう。
blocks.translation: If that were the case, there would be almost no choice to make.

blocks.source: 僧侶が全員にベホマラー、残り三人は攻撃。
blocks.translation: The Priest uses Multiheal on everyone, and the other three attack.

blocks.source: これ以外を考える必要はない。
blocks.translation: There would be no need to consider anything else.

blocks.source: 戦闘不能や状態異常がなければ、どんな危機からでも一度の回復で立て直せてしまう。全員が瀕死だろうが、一人がわずかなダメージを受けただけだろうが、大差はない。
blocks.translation: As long as no one is incapacitated or afflicted with a status ailment, a single heal can recover from any crisis. It makes little difference whether everyone is near death or only one person has taken minor damage.

blocks.source: それどころか、蘇生まで簡単にできてしまう作品も時々見られる。
blocks.translation: In fact, some games even make reviving fallen characters easy.

blocks.source: 全員を瀕死に追い込む強力な全体攻撃を喰らっても、全体全回復すればいい。
blocks.translation: Even if the party is hit by a powerful full-party attack that brings everyone near death, you can simply use full-party full healing.

blocks.source: 一撃必殺の強力な単体攻撃を喰らっても、蘇生すればいい。
blocks.translation: Even if someone is hit by a powerful single-target attack that kills them in one blow, you can simply revive them.

blocks.source: 極端になれば、こういった行動を毎ターン繰り返すだけになる。
blocks.translation: Taken to an extreme, the player would merely repeat these actions every turn.

blocks.source: 外面だけは激しく緊張感があるように見えるかもしれない。けれど、実態はパターン化した単調作業に近い。
blocks.translation: On the surface, it might look intensely suspenseful. In reality, however, it is little more than a monotonous, pattern-based task.

blocks.source: なんせ、プレイヤーの選択肢が攻撃と回復の実質二択しかない。
blocks.translation: After all, the player effectively has only two choices: attack or heal.

blocks.source: つまり、初代ドラクエ（一人旅）において『ホイミ／ベホイミ』で回復しながら、殴り合っているのと大差ない。ゲーム性が昭和の時代から進歩してないのだから、そりゃあ面白くないはず。
blocks.translation: In other words, it is barely any different from trading blows in the original Dragon Quest (with only one character) while healing with Heal/Midheal. If the gameplay has not progressed since the Showa era, it is no wonder that it is not interesting.

blocks.source: 蘇生常態化の問題点
blocks.translation: Problems with Making Revivals Routine

blocks.source: さらに言うと、蘇生が常態化したバランスの問題点は納得感や爽快感に欠けることだ。
blocks.translation: Moreover, the problem with a balance where reviving fallen characters is routine is that it lacks a sense of conviction and exhilaration.

blocks.source: というのも、本来ゲームにおける戦闘不能（死亡）とはプレイヤーの失敗を意味する。
blocks.translation: The reason is that, fundamentally, being incapacitated (dying) in a game represents a failure on the player’s part.

blocks.source: 戦闘不能と蘇生を繰り返すということは、何度も失敗を見せられるということである。簡単に立て直せるとはいっても、決して気分がよいものではない。
blocks.translation: Repeating incapacitation and revival means being shown failure over and over again. Even if recovery is easy, it is by no means a pleasant experience.

blocks.source: で、あるならば、わざわざそんなバランスにする必要はないのでは？――というのが僕の意見。
blocks.translation: If that is the case, then is there really any need to deliberately create such a balance? That is my opinion.

blocks.source: バランス調整案
blocks.translation: Proposals for Balance Adjustments

blocks.source: それでもあえて、コストが低くかつ強力な回復手段が存在する前提で、バランス調整する方法を考えてみよう。主にボス戦を想定してみた。
blocks.translation: Even so, let’s consider ways to balance the game on the assumption that low-cost yet powerful healing methods exist. Let’s mainly consider boss battles.

blocks.source: 敵をしぶとくする
blocks.translation: Make Enemies More Resilient

blocks.source: コストの低い回復魔法ですら、底を突きかねない程に敵をしぶとくする。
blocks.translation: Make enemies so resilient that even low-cost healing spells could run out of resources.

blocks.source: いかに節約させるかをプレイヤーに要求することになる。
blocks.translation: This requires the player to carefully conserve their resources.

blocks.source: 酷い場合はＭＰだけでなく、アイテム（それも９９個とか）が底を突くまで戦闘が長引く場合も。
blocks.translation: In extreme cases, battles may drag on until not only MP but also items—even 99 of them—run out.

blocks.source: 行き過ぎると、果てしなくダルい。個人的に勘弁して欲しいバランスの筆頭。
blocks.translation: Take it too far, and it becomes unbearably tedious. Personally, this is one of the balance approaches I would most like to avoid.

blocks.source: 敵の攻撃を激しくする
blocks.translation: Make Enemy Attacks More Intense

blocks.source: ＨＰが全快の状態からでも、１ターンの行動で死人が出るほど激しくする。
blocks.translation: Make them powerful enough to kill someone in a single turn, even when the party’s HP is completely full.

blocks.source: 安全に受け切るには、装備を整えたり、防御魔法などで守る必要がある。
blocks.translation: To withstand them safely, the player must prepare their equipment or use defensive magic to protect the party.

blocks.source: あるいは戦闘不能者が出る前提で、蘇生などの立て直し技能をプレイヤーに要求する。
blocks.translation: Alternatively, assume that someone will become incapacitated and require the player to use recovery skills such as reviving them.

blocks.source: この調整だと、安全に１ターンを受けられるようになれば、勝ちはほぼ確定する。
blocks.translation: With this approach, once the player can safely survive a single turn, victory is practically assured.

blocks.source: プレイヤーのミスを誘う
blocks.translation: Provoke Player Mistakes

blocks.source: プレイヤーのミス・判断遅れを誘って、パーティを崩壊させる。
blocks.translation: Provoke player mistakes or delayed decisions and cause the party to collapse.

blocks.source: 主にＦＦのＡＴＢなど、リアルタイム性があるシステムで実現しやすい。
blocks.translation: This is particularly easy to achieve in real-time systems such as Final Fantasy’s ATB.

blocks.source: 運の要素を入れる
blocks.translation: Add an Element of Luck

blocks.source: クリティカルや低確率で放つ強力な攻撃を織り交ぜる。運が悪ければ、回復役が即死してしまってピンチに。
blocks.translation: Mix in critical hits and powerful attacks that are used at low probabilities. If luck is not on their side, the healer may be killed instantly, putting the party in a difficult situation.

blocks.source: あるいは、行動順序にランダム性を持たせる。
blocks.translation: Alternatively, add randomness to the action order.

blocks.source: 回復役がボスに確定で先行（あるいは確定で後行）できない状態ならば、安定した回復は難しい。運が悪ければ、連続で攻撃を受けてしまうかもしれない。それによって、一定の緊張感を醸し出す。
blocks.translation: If the healer cannot be guaranteed to act before—or after—the boss, maintaining stable healing becomes difficult. If luck is not on their side, they may be attacked repeatedly. This creates a certain degree of tension.

blocks.source: ドラクエによくある場面ですね。
blocks.translation: This is a common situation in Dragon Quest.

blocks.source: 状態異常
blocks.translation: Status Ailments

blocks.source: 状態異常を織り交ぜることで、毎ターンの全体回復だけでは間に合わないようにする。
blocks.translation: Mix in status ailments so that healing the entire party once per turn is not enough.

blocks.source: 全体大ダメージ＋状態異常という悪夢のような技が、当たり前に存在するゲームも。
blocks.translation: Some games routinely include nightmarish skills that deal heavy damage to the entire party while also inflicting status ailments.

blocks.source: 完全な対策が得られるなら、勝ちは確定する。
blocks.translation: If a complete countermeasure is available, victory is assured.

blocks.source: 完全な対策がないなら、上と同じで『運の要素』が絡んでくる。
blocks.translation: If there is no complete countermeasure, then, as above, an element of luck comes into play.

blocks.source: 相性の要素を入れる
blocks.translation: Add Compatibility Factors

blocks.source: 相性が悪い攻撃を喰らえば、１ターンで戦闘不能に追い込まれるようにする。これはメガテンシリーズなどが有名。
blocks.translation: Make poorly matched attacks capable of incapacitating someone in a single turn. The Shin Megami Tensei series is famous for this.

blocks.source: 以上の通り、対策が極端なものばかりになっていることが分かるはず。
blocks.translation: As you can see, all of these countermeasures are rather extreme.

blocks.source: 味方の回復がインフレするならば、敵の攻撃もインフレさせなければ釣り合いが取れないというわけだ。
blocks.translation: If the party’s healing power is inflated, the enemies’ attacks must also be inflated to keep things balanced.

blocks.source: 長々と戦った末に、ＭＰが切れて全滅
blocks.translation: The entire party is wiped out after a long battle when they run out of MP

blocks.source: 適切な防御手段を取らなければ全滅
blocks.translation: The entire party is wiped out if the player does not use the appropriate defensive measures

blocks.source: 操作ミスすれば全滅
blocks.translation: The entire party is wiped out if the player makes an input mistake

blocks.source: 運が悪ければ全滅
blocks.translation: The entire party is wiped out if luck is not on their side

blocks.source: 状態異常に対処できなければ全滅
blocks.translation: The entire party is wiped out if the player cannot deal with status ailments

blocks.source: 装備や仲間の相性が悪ければ全滅
blocks.translation: The entire party is wiped out if their equipment or party members are poorly matched

blocks.source: これらはかなり危ういバランスといえる。
blocks.translation: These can all be considered highly precarious balance choices.

blocks.source: 長期戦の末の全滅は、消え去った時間の長さからプレイヤーの心を折りやすい。かといって、対策不足や運の悪さで瞬殺されてしまうのも、やはり無理だと諦めてしまいやすい。
blocks.translation: Being wiped out after a long battle can be discouraging because of all the time the player has lost. On the other hand, being killed instantly due to inadequate preparation or bad luck also makes it easy for players to give up and conclude that victory is impossible.

blocks.source: 一歩間違えれば、単なる運ゲー、理不尽ゲーでしかなくなる。
blocks.translation: With one wrong step, the game becomes nothing more than a game of luck or an unfair game.

blocks.source: 回復手段を制限しなかった結果、皮肉にもライトユーザに厳しいゲームになってしまうわけだ。
blocks.translation: As a result of not restricting healing methods, the game ironically ends up being harsh on casual players.

blocks.source: どうしても、強力で手軽な回復を使いたいならば、いっそヌルゲーにしてしまうのも一つの手。
blocks.translation: If you absolutely want to use powerful and convenient healing, one option is to simply make the game extremely easy.

blocks.source: 普通にやっていれば全滅しないし、ボス戦も長引かない。
blocks.translation: As long as the player plays normally, the party will not be wiped out, and boss battles will not drag on.

blocks.source: ゲーム性は低いし、手応えはないが、快適ではある。そうやってライトユーザ向けを狙う。
blocks.translation: The gameplay is shallow and lacks challenge, but it is comfortable to play. That approach targets casual players.

blocks.source: 正直、大して何も考えず強力な回復を用意するよりは、これぐらい開き直ったほうが筋も通っているかもしれない。
blocks.translation: To be honest, rather than providing powerful healing without giving it much thought, it may be more consistent to commit to this approach wholeheartedly.

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Summary

blocks.source: このように、強すぎる回復は戦闘バランスを破壊しやすく、調整が非常に難しい。素直に強力な回復手段は制限したほうがよいというのが、筆者の意見となる。
blocks.translation: As you can see, healing that is too powerful can easily destroy the battle balance and is extremely difficult to adjust. My opinion is that it is better to straightforwardly restrict powerful healing methods.

blocks.source: 誰を回復するか？
blocks.translation: Who should you heal?

blocks.source: ひとまず防御させてしのぐか？
blocks.translation: Should you have them defend for now to weather the attack?

blocks.source: 今は回復せず、ＭＰを温存しておくか？
blocks.translation: Should you refrain from healing for now and conserve MP?

blocks.source: ここはＭＰを大きく消費してでも全体回復しようか？
blocks.translation: Should you spend a large amount of MP to heal the entire party?

blocks.source: バランスのよいＲＰＧは、こういった色んな判断を求められるようになっている。判断を求められてこそ、真の緊張感は生まれるといえる。
blocks.translation: A well-balanced RPG requires players to make all kinds of decisions like these. True tension arises precisely when players are required to make decisions.

blocks.source: 回復手段を適切に制限することで、緊張感を保とう。
blocks.translation: Maintain tension by appropriately restricting healing methods.

texts.極端になれば、こういった行動を毎ターン繰り返すだけになる。: Taken to an extreme, the player would merely repeat these actions every turn.
texts.外面だけは激しく緊張感があるように見えるかもしれない。けれど、実態はパターン化し: On the surface, it might look intensely suspenseful. In reality, however, it is little more than a monotonous, pattern-based task.
texts.なんせ、プレイヤーの選択肢が攻撃と回復の実質二択しかない。: After all, the player effectively has only two choices: attack or heal.
texts.つまり、初代ドラクエ（一人旅）において『ホイミ／ベホイミ』で回復しながら、殴り合: In other words, it is barely any different from trading blows in the original Dragon Quest (with only one character) while healing with Heal/Midheal. If the gameplay has not progressed since the Showa era, it is no wonder that it is not interesting.
texts.さらに言うと、蘇生が常態化したバランスの問題点は納得感や爽快感に欠けることだ。: Moreover, the problem with a balance where reviving fallen characters is routine is that it lacks a sense of conviction and exhilaration.
texts.というのも、本来ゲームにおける戦闘不能（死亡）とはプレイヤーの失敗を意味する。: The reason is that, fundamentally, being incapacitated (dying) in a game represents a failure on the player’s part.
texts.戦闘不能と蘇生を繰り返すということは、何度も失敗を見せられるということである。簡: Repeating incapacitation and revival means being shown failure over and over again. Even if recovery is easy, it is by no means a pleasant experience.
texts.で、あるならば、わざわざそんなバランスにする必要はないのでは？――というのが僕の: If that is the case, then is there really any need to deliberately create such a balance? That is my opinion.
texts.それでもあえて、コストが低くかつ強力な回復手段が存在する前提で、バランス調整する: Even so, let’s consider ways to balance the game on the assumption that low-cost yet powerful healing methods exist. Let’s mainly consider boss battles.
texts.コストの低い回復魔法ですら、底を突きかねない程に敵をしぶとくする。: Make enemies so resilient that even low-cost healing spells could run out of resources.
texts.いかに節約させるかをプレイヤーに要求することになる。: This requires the player to carefully conserve their resources.
texts.酷い場合はＭＰだけでなく、アイテム（それも９９個とか）が底を突くまで戦闘が長引く: In extreme cases, battles may drag on until not only MP but also items—even 99 of them—run out.
texts.行き過ぎると、果てしなくダルい。個人的に勘弁して欲しいバランスの筆頭。: Take it too far, and it becomes unbearably tedious. Personally, this is one of the balance approaches I would most like to avoid.
texts.ＨＰが全快の状態からでも、１ターンの行動で死人が出るほど激しくする。: Make them powerful enough to kill someone in a single turn, even when the party’s HP is completely full.
texts.安全に受け切るには、装備を整えたり、防御魔法などで守る必要がある。: To withstand them safely, the player must prepare their equipment or use defensive magic to protect the party.
texts.あるいは戦闘不能者が出る前提で、蘇生などの立て直し技能をプレイヤーに要求する。: Alternatively, assume that someone will become incapacitated and require the player to use recovery skills such as reviving them.
texts.この調整だと、安全に１ターンを受けられるようになれば、勝ちはほぼ確定する。: With this approach, once the player can safely survive a single turn, victory is practically assured.
texts.プレイヤーのミス・判断遅れを誘って、パーティを崩壊させる。: Provoke player mistakes or delayed decisions and cause the party to collapse.
texts.主にＦＦのＡＴＢなど、リアルタイム性があるシステムで実現しやすい。: This is particularly easy to achieve in real-time systems such as Final Fantasy’s ATB.
texts.クリティカルや低確率で放つ強力な攻撃を織り交ぜる。運が悪ければ、回復役が即死して: Mix in critical hits and powerful attacks that are used at low probabilities. If luck is not on their side, the healer may be killed instantly, putting the party in a difficult situation.
texts.あるいは、行動順序にランダム性を持たせる。: Alternatively, add randomness to the action order.
texts.回復役がボスに確定で先行（あるいは確定で後行）できない状態ならば、安定した回復は: If the healer cannot be guaranteed to act before—or after—the boss, maintaining stable healing becomes difficult. If luck is not on their side, they may be attacked repeatedly. This creates a certain degree of tension.
texts.ドラクエによくある場面ですね。: This is a common situation in Dragon Quest.
texts.状態異常を織り交ぜることで、毎ターンの全体回復だけでは間に合わないようにする。: Mix in status ailments so that healing the entire party once per turn is not enough.
texts.全体大ダメージ＋状態異常という悪夢のような技が、当たり前に存在するゲームも。: Some games routinely include nightmarish skills that deal heavy damage to the entire party while also inflicting status ailments.
texts.完全な対策が得られるなら、勝ちは確定する。: If a complete countermeasure is available, victory is assured.
texts.完全な対策がないなら、上と同じで『運の要素』が絡んでくる。: If there is no complete countermeasure, then, as above, an element of luck comes into play.
texts.相性が悪い攻撃を喰らえば、１ターンで戦闘不能に追い込まれるようにする。これはメガ: Make poorly matched attacks capable of incapacitating someone in a single turn. The Shin Megami Tensei series is famous for this.
texts.以上の通り、対策が極端なものばかりになっていることが分かるはず。: As you can see, all of these countermeasures are rather extreme.
texts.味方の回復がインフレするならば、敵の攻撃もインフレさせなければ釣り合いが取れない: If the party’s healing power is inflated, the enemies’ attacks must also be inflated to keep things balanced.
texts.長々と戦った末に、ＭＰが切れて全滅: The entire party is wiped out after a long battle when they run out of MP
texts.適切な防御手段を取らなければ全滅: The entire party is wiped out if the player does not use the appropriate defensive measures
texts.操作ミスすれば全滅: The entire party is wiped out if the player makes an input mistake
texts.運が悪ければ全滅: The entire party is wiped out if luck is not on their side
texts.状態異常に対処できなければ全滅: The entire party is wiped out if the player cannot deal with status ailments
texts.装備や仲間の相性が悪ければ全滅: The entire party is wiped out if their equipment or party members are poorly matched
texts.これらはかなり危ういバランスといえる。: These can all be considered highly precarious balance choices.
texts.長期戦の末の全滅は、消え去った時間の長さからプレイヤーの心を折りやすい。かといっ: Being wiped out after a long battle can be discouraging because of all the time the player has lost. On the other hand, being killed instantly due to inadequate preparation or bad luck also makes it easy for players to give up and conclude that victory is impossible.
texts.一歩間違えれば、単なる運ゲー、理不尽ゲーでしかなくなる。: With one wrong step, the game becomes nothing more than a game of luck or an unfair game.
texts.回復手段を制限しなかった結果、皮肉にもライトユーザに厳しいゲームになってしまうわ: As a result of not restricting healing methods, the game ironically ends up being harsh on casual players.
texts.どうしても、強力で手軽な回復を使いたいならば、いっそヌルゲーにしてしまうのも一つ: If you absolutely want to use powerful and convenient healing, one option is to simply make the game extremely easy.
texts.普通にやっていれば全滅しないし、ボス戦も長引かない。: As long as the player plays normally, the party will not be wiped out, and boss battles will not drag on.
texts.ゲーム性は低いし、手応えはないが、快適ではある。そうやってライトユーザ向けを狙う: The gameplay is shallow and lacks challenge, but it is comfortable to play. That approach targets casual players.
texts.正直、大して何も考えず強力な回復を用意するよりは、これぐらい開き直ったほうが筋も: To be honest, rather than providing powerful healing without giving it much thought, it may be more consistent to commit to this approach wholeheartedly.
texts.このように、強すぎる回復は戦闘バランスを破壊しやすく、調整が非常に難しい。素直に: As you can see, healing that is too powerful can easily destroy the battle balance and is extremely difficult to adjust. My opinion is that it is better to straightforwardly restrict powerful healing methods.
texts.ひとまず防御させてしのぐか？: Should you have them defend for now to weather the attack?
texts.今は回復せず、ＭＰを温存しておくか？: Should you refrain from healing for now and conserve MP?
texts.ここはＭＰを大きく消費してでも全体回復しようか？: Should you spend a large amount of MP to heal the entire party?
texts.バランスのよいＲＰＧは、こういった色んな判断を求められるようになっている。判断を: A well-balanced RPG requires players to make all kinds of decisions like these. True tension arises precisely when players are required to make decisions.
texts.回復手段を適切に制限することで、緊張感を保とう。: Maintain tension by appropriately restricting healing methods.
